issue.title: Fix marking of custom routes for Journey
issue.body:
The Mapper build_path method marks routes where path parameters are part of a path segment as custom routes by altering the regular expression, e.g:

``` ruby
get '/foo-:bar', to: 'foo#bar'
```

There were some edge cases where certain constructs weren't being picked up and this commit fixes those.

Fixes #23069.

/cc @tenderlove @eileencodes
